title: The surprise party
summary: Six friends try to organise a secret party, but the birthday girl seems to know everything.
paragraphs: Lucía's eighteenth birthday was on a Friday, and her friends wanted to give her a surprise party. They made a group chat called "Operation Cake" and promised to keep everything secret. Marcos would {{distract}} Lucía. Irene would decorate the flat. Javi would bring the music. Everyone else would bring food.

The problems started on Monday. Javi accidentally sent a message about balloons to Lucía instead of the group. He quickly wrote, "Sorry, wrong person! It's for my cousin." On Tuesday, Lucía saw Irene in a shop with fifty paper plates. Irene said she was having a picnic. In November.

On Wednesday, Lucía asked Marcos, "Are you free on Friday evening?" Marcos panicked. "No! I mean, yes. I mean, maybe," he said. "Why?" Lucía just smiled. "No reason," she said. The friends were sure she knew. They had an {{emergency}} meeting and almost {{cancelled}} the whole thing.

On Friday evening, Marcos took Lucía to the cinema. The film was terrible, but he didn't care. At nine o'clock he said, "Let's go to Irene's flat. She wants to give you something." When Lucía opened the door, the lights came on and twenty people shouted "Surprise!" Lucía screamed, then laughed, then cried a little.

Later that night, the friends asked her, "So, did you know?" Lucía looked at them seriously. "I knew something was happening," she said. "But I thought you were planning to {{move}} me to a new flat, because Irene had all those plates." They all laughed. The next morning, they changed the name of the group chat to "Operation Cake: Mission Complete", and they started planning Marcos's birthday in March.

distract.meaning: take someone's attention away from something

cancelled.meaning: decided that a planned event would not happen

move.meaning: help someone take their things to a new home

emergency.meaning: a sudden serious situation that needs fast action
